SELECT
  u.id AS userId,
  u.nom,
  u.prenom,
  u.email,
  r.nom_role AS role_code,
  e.apogee,
  e.niveau,
  e.semestre_actuel,
  e.etat_inscription,
  c.nom AS classe,
  (
    SELECT JSON_ARRAYAGG(
      JSON_OBJECT(
        'matiere', m.nom,
        'note', res.note,
        'type', ex.type_examen,
        'date', DATE_FORMAT(ex.date_examen, '%d/%m/%Y')
      )
    )
    FROM resultat res
    JOIN examen ex ON ex.id = res.examen_id
    JOIN matiere m ON m.id = ex.matiere_id
    WHERE res.etudiant_id = u.id
    LIMIT 10
  ) AS notes,
  (
    SELECT CONCAT(
      SUM(CASE WHEN p.status = 'PRESENT' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),
      ' présences / ', COUNT(*), ' séances'
    )
    FROM presence p
    WHERE p.etudiant_id = u.id
  ) AS presences,
  (
    SELECT JSON_ARRAYAGG(
      JSON_OBJECT(
        'matiere', m.nom,
        'date', DATE_FORMAT(s.date, '%d/%m/%Y'),
        'debut', DATE_FORMAT(s.heure_debut, '%H:%i'),
        'fin', DATE_FORMAT(s.heure_fin, '%H:%i'),
        'salle', s.salle,
        'type', s.type,
        'etat', s.etat
      )
    )
    FROM seance s
    JOIN affectation_enseignement ae ON ae.id = s.affectation_enseignement_id
    JOIN matiere m ON m.id = ae.matiere_id
    WHERE ae.classe_id = e.classe_id
      AND s.date >= CURDATE()
    LIMIT 10
  ) AS prochaines_seances,
  (
    SELECT JSON_ARRAYAGG(
      JSON_OBJECT(
        'titre', a.titre,
        'contenu', a.contenu,
        'urgent', IF(a.urgent = 1, 'OUI', 'NON'),
        'date', DATE_FORMAT(a.date_publication, '%d/%m/%Y')
      )
    )
    FROM annonce a
    WHERE a.publiee = 1
      AND (
        a.cible_type = 'ETUDIANTS_GLOBAL'
        OR (a.cible_type = 'ETUDIANTS_CLASSE' AND a.classe_id = e.classe_id)
      )
    ORDER BY a.date_publication DESC
    LIMIT 5
  ) AS annonces_etudiant,
  p.specialite,
  p.grade AS grade_prof,
  (
    SELECT JSON_ARRAYAGG(
      JSON_OBJECT(
        'matiere', m.nom,
        'classe', cl.nom,
        'annee', ae.annee_universitaire
      )
    )
    FROM affectation_enseignement ae
    JOIN matiere m ON m.id = ae.matiere_id
    JOIN classe cl ON cl.id = ae.classe_id
    WHERE ae.professeur_id = u.id AND ae.active = 1
  ) AS matieres_prof,
  (
    SELECT JSON_ARRAYAGG(
      JSON_OBJECT(
        'titre', a.titre,
        'contenu', a.contenu,
        'urgent', IF(a.urgent = 1, 'OUI', 'NON'),
        'date', DATE_FORMAT(a.date_publication, '%d/%m/%Y')
      )
    )
    FROM annonce a
    WHERE a.publiee = 1
      AND a.cible_type IN ('PROFESSEURS_GLOBAL','PROFESSEURS_DEPARTEMENT')
    ORDER BY a.date_publication DESC
    LIMIT 5
  ) AS annonces_prof
FROM utilisateur u
JOIN utilisateur_role ur ON ur.utilisateur_id = u.id
JOIN role r ON r.id = ur.role_id
LEFT JOIN etudiant e ON e.utilisateur_id = u.id
LEFT JOIN classe c ON c.id = e.classe_id
LEFT JOIN professeur p ON p.utilisateur_id = u.id
WHERE u.id = {{ $json.userId }}
LIMIT 1;

SELECT
  fs.id,
  fs.nom_original,
  fs.chemin,
  fs.type_mime,
  DATE_FORMAT(fs.date_upload, '%d/%m/%Y') AS date_upload,
  m.nom AS matiere,
  s.type AS type_seance,
  DATE_FORMAT(s.date, '%d/%m/%Y') AS date_seance,
  c.nom AS classe
FROM fichier_seance fs
JOIN seance s ON s.id = fs.seance_id
JOIN affectation_enseignement ae ON ae.id = s.affectation_enseignement_id
JOIN matiere m ON m.id = ae.matiere_id
JOIN classe c ON c.id = ae.classe_id
WHERE
  (
    '{{ $('Guardrail IN').first().json.role }}' = 'ETUDIANT'
    AND ae.classe_id = (
      SELECT classe_id FROM etudiant
      WHERE utilisateur_id = {{ $('Guardrail IN').first().json.userId }}
    )
  )
  OR (
    '{{ $('Guardrail IN').first().json.role }}' = 'PROFESSEUR'
    AND ae.professeur_id = {{ $('Guardrail IN').first().json.userId }}
  )
  OR '{{ $('Guardrail IN').first().json.role }}' = 'ADMIN'
ORDER BY fs.date_upload DESC
LIMIT 20;
